paragraphs.en: Color is {fundamental} in home design—something you'll always have in every room.A {grasp} of how to manage color in your spaces is one of the first steps to creating rooms that reflect your {preference} .Do you want a room that's full of life? {Professional} ? Or are you just looking for a place to relax after a long day? A {bright} {yellow} {accent} wall can make a room feel {livelier} . {Blue} tones are often associated with calmness.An {elegant} combination of colors can transform a simple room into a special space.
paragraphs.cn: 色彩是家居设计的 <u> 基本 </u> 要素——每个房间都会用到色彩。 <u> 掌握 </u> 如何在室内空间中运用色彩，是打造出能体现个人 <u> 喜好 </u> 的房间的首要步骤之一。你想要一个充满活力的房间吗？还是一个显得 <u> 专业的 </u> 房间？又或者你只想寻找一个在漫长的一天后可以放松一下的地方？一面 <u> 明亮的黄色装饰 </u> 墙能让房间显得更有 <u> 活力 </u> 。 <u> 蓝色 </u> 调通常与平静安宁联系在一起。 <u> 优雅的 </u> 色彩搭配能将一个简单的房间打造成一个别具一格的空间。

paragraphs.en: Over the years, there have been a number of different techniques to help {designers} approach this important point.Many people feel {confused} about the endless color {shades} and {mixes} available.The {difficulty} lies in choosing colors that match your personal {taste} while also {complementing} the existing {components} of your room.An {unsuitable} color can even {disturb} the overall harmony.But the good news is that there are really only three kinds of decisions you need to make about color in your home: the small ones, the {medium} ones, and the large ones.
paragraphs.cn: 多年来， <u> 设计师 </u> 们采用了许多不同的技巧来处理这一重要问题。可供选择的色彩 <u> 色调 </u> 和 <u> 配色组合 </u> 无穷无尽，许多人对此感到 <u> 困惑 </u> 。 <u> 难点 </u> 在于选择既符合个人 <u> 品位 </u> ，又能与房间现有 <u> 元素 </u> 互相 <u> 衬托 </u> 的颜色。 <u> 不合适的 </u> 色彩甚至会 <u> 打破 </u> 整体的和谐感。不过，好消息是，关于家居色彩，其实你只需要做三类决定：小面积的、 <u> 中等面积的 </u> 和大面积的色彩决定。

paragraphs.en: Small color choices are the ones we're most familiar with.They're the little spots of color like {throw} {pillows} , {mirrors} and baskets that most of us use to {decorate} our rooms.Adding {fabric} and {metal} elements through small color choices gives depth and interest to the space.Less tiring than painting your walls and less expensive than buying a colorful {sofa} , small color choices bring with them the significant benefit of being easily {changeable} .
paragraphs.cn: 小面积色彩选择是我们最熟悉的一种。它们是那些小小的色彩点缀，比如 <u> 抱枕 </u> 、 <u> 镜子 </u> 和篮子，我们大多数人用它们来 <u> 装饰 </u> 房间。通过小面积的色彩选择来添加 <u> 织物 </u> 和 <u> 金属 </u> 元素，可以为空间增添层次感和趣味。与粉刷墙壁相比不那么累人，又比买一个彩色 <u> 沙发 </u> 更加经济实惠，小面积的色彩选择还具有 <u> 易于更换 </u> 这一显著的优势。

paragraphs.en: Medium color choices are generally furniture pieces such as sofas, {curtains} , {carpets} or {bookshelves} .They require a bigger commitment than smaller ones, and they have a more {powerful} effect on the feeling of a space.Introducing medium colors that {contrast} with the background can add a sense of {dynamic} energy to a room.Alternatively ( (或者) ), choosing colors that blend well can help {integrate} different parts of the room.
paragraphs.cn: 中等面积的色彩选择通常指沙发、 <u> 窗帘 </u> 、 <u> 地毯 </u> 或 <u> 书架 </u> 等家具。相比小面积的色彩选择，它们需要更大的投入，而且对空间氛围有更 <u> 强的 </u> 影响力。引入与背景形成 <u> 对比 </u> 的中等面积色彩，可以为房间增添一种 <u> 充满活力的 </u> 感觉。或者，选择搭配和谐的颜色有助于将房间的不同部分更好地 <u> 融为一体 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: The large color decisions in your rooms concern the walls, {ceilings} , and floors.These colors {comprise} the main visual elements and often {dominate} the overall appearance.They significantly affect your {surrounding} environment.Whether you're looking at {wallpaper} or paint, the time, effort and {relative} expense put into it are significant.So you should consult with an {architect} during the {construction} phase to help ensure that your major color choices match your design goals.
paragraphs.cn: 你房间中的大面积色彩选择涉及墙面、 <u> 天花板 </u> 和地面。这些颜色 <u> 构成 </u> 了主要的视觉元素，通常 <u> 主导 </u> 着整体外观。它们对 <u> 周围 </u> 环境的影响非常明显。无论你考虑的是 <u> 壁纸 </u> 还是油漆，都需要投入大量的时间、精力和 <u> 相对 </u> 花销。因此，在 <u> 施工 </u> 阶段，你应该与 <u> 建筑师 </u> 商议，以确保你的主要色彩选择与你的设计目标相契合。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
